newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends at lows, near major support.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends at lows, near major support.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures settled near the day's lows as the speculators triggered stop loss selling once the spot-March contract fell under 10.55 cents a lb, floor sources said.
They noted light trade buying on the close but said the market is likely to encounter resistance on rallies due to the global supply and demand picture, which remains bearish for prices.
"We are not getting the offtake and reports of production will keep it under pressure even though the funds are on the short side," a dealer said.
"The market has no bounce to it at all."
Spot March finished 0.16 lower at 10.54 after trading from 10.73 to 10.53. The deferred months ended 0.12 to 0.05 weaker.
Resistance remained at 10.80 and support at 10.50 and then 10.35 for March sugar. Several dealers expect the contract to fall towards 10.00.
